metadata.scenario_context: Victoria, a single working mother, is trying to organize a surprise party for her son's birthday which she thinks would help in bonding with her child.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Thailand strongly agree that when a mother works for pay, the children suffer.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Jordan strongly disagree that when a mother works for pay, the children suffer.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss wrap the gift in green for the party.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether that a mother works for pay and the children suffer.

agent_2.goal_1: decide on what type of gift and what color to wrap it in for the birthday party for Victoria's son.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss the concept that when a mother works for pay, the children suffer.

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: Hello Ray, I'm helping Victoria with her son's birthday party. I think we should wrap the gift in green, it's a nice color. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Ray
shared_prefix.message: I think blue would be a better choice, it's a more traditional color for boys in our culture. What kind of gift were you thinking of getting for him anyway?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: I don't really see meaningful differences here, people figure it out, and at the end of the day it's all the same. Live and let live, right? Doesn't matter to me. So, about the gift, I was thinking maybe something fun for the kid to play with. What kind of things is he into?
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Ray
turns.message: Well, I've heard Victoria mention he likes Legos. But to be honest, I'm more concerned about the fact that Victoria's working so much, I hope it's not affecting her relationship with her son. I'm sure it's not, though, I mean, many mothers work and their children turn out just fine.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Jack
